candidate.rationale: The ToRef trait already supplies `res.deep_view() == self.deep_view()`; repeating it locally adds no contract strength.
risks: A duplicate implementation-level contract may be unsupported or redundant.

candidate.rationale: No additional semantically useful postcondition is expressible here: `ToRef::get_ref` already guarantees preservation of the complete string deep view, while aliasing/backing-storage identity is not represented by the available Verus view-level specification.
risks: Adding a length, character, or equality condition would be derivable from the trait contract and therefore redundant; attempting to specify pointer identity would rely on unsupported or non-portable implementation details.
